entry.title: I Told an AI Agent That Its Wrong Answers Were Right. One Model Believed Me.
entry.summary: A research paper claims reward labels barely change how agents learn. I tested that on three models, and one of them did exactly what the wrong labels told it to. The post I Told an AI Agent That Its Wrong Answers Were Right. One Model Believed Me. appeared first on Towards Data Science.

entry.title: HairDeck: Animation-Ready Stylized Hair Cards from a Single Image
entry.summary: The hair of stylized characters in games and avatars is built from hair cards: artist-placed ribbons whose geometry is the visible hair, animated by spring bones.
